summary: Party-status / field marker overlay controller stored at (scene work + 0x48): owns up to 12 character marker entries (0xC-byte rows at +0x210), the selected page/mode bytes, the enable/animation state of the party display, and an embedded ribbon-trail block whose vertex-strip buffers live at +0x4A2C..+0x4A34.
evidence: Same object is passed as (work+8)->f_48 to Party_Status_AddMember (0x00239510, from PartyAdd 0x001653BC), to Party_Status_RemoveMember (0x0023B628, from PartyRemove 0x0014859C) and to Ui_OverlayManager_Reset (0x00235848, from the scene-work teardown 0x0019ECE4). Party_Status_SelectPage (0x00239A94) is called with the same self by Ui_Overlay_ApplySlotSetup (0x00235E0C), which also calls Gfx_Trail_ResetSamples(self,...), and Ui_Overlay_Update (0x0023D988) reads the trail buffers and +0x4B30 on the same self. Size 0x4B34: the highest accessed byte is +0x4B30 (read in Ui_Overlay_Update), while the batch's 644 only counts the low strong fields; structs.json already records size_min 19249.

fields.name: isInitialized
fields.evidence: Ui_OverlayManager_Reset (0x00235848) tears the object down and clears this byte when it is set, then sets it to 1 after allocating its buffers; Ui_Overlay_Update (0x0023D988) returns 0 immediately while it is 0.

fields.name: markersEnabled
fields.evidence: Ui_Overlay_ApplySlotSetup (0x00235E0C) starts with self->f_11 = 1; Ui_Overlay_AddEntry (0x0023E4A8) returns without creating an entry while it is 0, and Party_Status_AddMember (0x00239510) only calls Ui_Overlay_AddEntry when it is non-zero (field-mode gates marker creation).

fields.name: maybe_closedStateEffect
fields.evidence: Object handle assigned from maybe_Effect_CreateFromVariantTable in Ui_Overlay_ApplySlotSetup (0x00235E0C) when the setup mode byte is 1 or 2; Party_Status_SetEnabled (0x0023C72C) resolves it through the 0x007B80C0 handle table (class 0x007C4E50) and calls Actor_SelectAttractAnimation on it when the display is disabled.

fields.name: maybe_openStateEffect
fields.evidence: Object handle assigned from Effect_CreateInstanceWithDefaults in Ui_Overlay_ApplySlotSetup (0x00235E0C) when the setup mode byte is 0 or 2; Party_Status_SetEnabled (0x0023C72C) resolves it through the 0x007B80C0 handle table (class 0x007C4E3C), plays Actor_PlayIdleAnimationForState when enabled, and pushes the enabled byte to its vtable slot +0x6C.

fields.name: entryCount
fields.evidence: Live marker-row count: Ui_Overlay_AddEntry (0x0023E4A8) refuses to add while f_278 (capacity at +0x278) <= f_274 and stores the new row at self + f_274*0xC + 0x210; Party_Status_SetEnabled (0x0023C72C) and Party_Status_SetMemberValue (0x00238A48) iterate i < f_274 over the same 0xC-stride rows.

fields.name: isEnabled
fields.evidence: Current enabled/shown state of the party display: Party_Status_SetEnabled (0x0023C72C) stores the requested flag here, sends it to the two state effects and to vtable slot +0x6C of every row widget; Ui_Overlay_CanShowMarkers (0x0023C398) and Ui_Overlay_UpdateMarkerTrail (0x00238F48) suppress drawing while it is 0.

fields.name: forceModeRefresh
fields.evidence: When non-zero, Party_Status_SetEnabled (0x0023C72C) and Ui_SetModeAndNotify (0x0023C998) re-send the mode to maybe_Ui_Window_ReleaseChildAndRequestMode even though +0x27E already holds it, then clear this byte; Ui_Overlay_ApplySlotSetup (0x00235E0C) sets it to 1 for setup mode 2 with byte 0.

fields.name: requestedMode
fields.evidence: Last mode value passed to maybe_Ui_Window_ReleaseChildAndRequestMode: compared against the new enabled flag in Party_Status_SetEnabled (0x0023C72C) and Ui_SetModeAndNotify (0x0023C998), and written from (mode[4] == 1) in Ui_Overlay_ApplySlotSetup (0x00235E0C).

fields.name: maybe_displayVariant
fields.evidence: Small variant enum (1..4) of the party display: Party_Status_SetMemberValue (0x00238A48) maps 1/2/4 to animation-block indices 0xF/0x11/0x12 (other values fall back to Party_ResolveAppearanceVariantIndex); Ui_Overlay_AvoidCollision (0x00238D88) doubles the avoidance step for 1..4, and it is the variant argument of Effect_CreateInstanceWithDefaults (0x00235E0C) and Field_CreateRenderObject (0x0023E4A8).

fields.name: pageAndMode
fields.evidence: Party_Status_SelectPage (0x00239A94) writes both bytes at once (f_281 = *(u16*)sel); the low byte is the selected page (0..0xB, 0xFF = none) compared against loop indices in Ui_Overlay_ApplySlotSetup (0x00235E0C), Ui_Overlay_RefreshSlots (0x00236C08), Ui_Overlay_TryTouchSelect (0x00237868) and maybe_Ui_Overlay_UpdateSlotVisibility (0x00237034), and Ui_OverlayManager_Reset (0x00235848) reloads it from GameWork +0x29F20/+0x29F21.

fields.name: modelPartsMode
fields.evidence: High byte of the page word: Party_Status_SelectPage (0x00239A94) passes it to maybe_Actor_ApplyModelPartsB(actor, f_281, f_282), and Ui_Overlay_ApplySlotSetup (0x00235E0C) fills it from setup->f_42 (page >= 0) while Ui_OverlayManager_Reset (0x00235848) copies GameWork +0x29F21.

fields.name: vertexStripBuffer
fields.evidence: First of three buffers allocated by Ui_OverlayManager_Reset (0x00235848) with Mem_AllocAligned(800, heap, 4) and freed via func_0010F69C; passed as piVar3 to func_006F511C by Gfx_Trail_PushSample (0x0023BBD4) and Gfx_Trail_ResetSamples (0x0023D518), which submit the 25-pair PICA200 vertex strip. Same offset named vertexStripBuffer in S_047/Gfx_Trail.

fields.name: maybe_vertexStripAuxBuffer
fields.evidence: Second buffer: Ui_OverlayManager_Reset (0x00235848) allocates it with Mem_AllocAligned(100, heap, 4), aborts the reset on null, frees it via func_0010F69C and checks it non-null before submitting the strip (Gfx_Trail_PushSample 0x0023BBD4 / Gfx_Trail_ResetSamples 0x0023D518); it is a buffer pointer, so S_047's +0x4A30 isVertexStripReady label is not used.

fields.name: maybe_vertexStripParamBuffer
fields.evidence: Third buffer: Ui_OverlayManager_Reset (0x00235848) allocates it with Mem_AllocAligned(100, heap, 4) and passes it as the destination/work argument of func_006F511C(&f_4a2c, 25-entry template, buffer) before storing it here; freed via func_0010F69C on failure. The 25-entry count lives at +0x4A38, not here.

fields.name: maybe_pendingRegistrationMode
fields.evidence: Ui_Overlay_Update (0x0023D988) registers an actor from self+0x4A88 and copies +0x4AE1 into +0x4ADB when this byte is non-zero, otherwise tries the +0x4AE4 record when +0x4B30 is set; all three bytes are then cleared. Ui_OverlayManager_Reset (0x00235848) and Ui_Overlay_ApplySlotSetup (0x00235E0C) clear it (0) together with +0x4AE1 (0xFF) and +0x4B30 (0).

fields.name: maybe_pendingRegistrationId
fields.evidence: Pending id/phase in the registration block: Ui_Overlay_Update (0x0023D988) copies it to +0x4ADB before registering the actor record at +0x4A88, and Ui_OverlayManager_Reset (0x00235848) / Ui_Overlay_ApplySlotSetup (0x00235E0C) reset it to 0xFF (none).

fields.name: maybe_pendingRegistrationModeB
fields.evidence: Second registration flag: Ui_Overlay_Update (0x0023D988) reads it when +0x4AE0 is 0 and, if set, registers the actor record at self+0x4AE4; Ui_OverlayManager_Reset (0x00235848) and Ui_Overlay_ApplySlotSetup (0x00235E0C) clear it with the other two registration bytes.
